CIS-CTL-4.1.title: Non-root container user
CIS-CTL-4.1.objective: Dockerfiles MUST specify a non-root USER to limit the impact of container breakout.

CIS-CTL-4.1.01.title: Non-root container user
CIS-CTL-4.1.01.text: The Dockerfile MUST contain at least one USER instruction.

CIS-CTL-4.1.02.title: Non-root container user
CIS-CTL-4.1.02.text: The last USER instruction MUST NOT specify root or UID 0.

CIS-CTL-4.3.title: Minimal base image
CIS-CTL-4.3.objective: Dockerfiles SHOULD use minimal base image variants (alpine, slim, distroless, scratch) to reduce attack surface.

CIS-CTL-4.3.01.title: Minimal base image
CIS-CTL-4.3.01.text: The FROM instruction SHOULD reference an alpine, slim, distroless, or scratch base image variant.  Full distribution images produce a warning.

CIS-CTL-4.6.title: Dockerfile HEALTHCHECK
CIS-CTL-4.6.objective: Dockerfiles MUST include a HEALTHCHECK instruction for container liveness detection.

CIS-CTL-4.6.01.title: Dockerfile HEALTHCHECK
CIS-CTL-4.6.01.text: The Dockerfile MUST contain at least one HEALTHCHECK instruction.

CIS-CTL-4.7.title: No standalone update instructions
CIS-CTL-4.7.objective: Package manager update commands MUST NOT appear without a corresponding install command.

CIS-CTL-4.7.01.title: No standalone update instructions
CIS-CTL-4.7.01.text: RUN instructions containing apt-get update, apk update, or yum update MUST also contain an install or add command.

CIS-CTL-4.8.title: SUID/SGID bit removal
CIS-CTL-4.8.objective: Dockerfiles SHOULD include a step that strips SUID and SGID bits from all binaries.

CIS-CTL-4.8.01.title: SUID/SGID bit removal
CIS-CTL-4.8.01.text: The Dockerfile SHOULD contain a RUN instruction that executes chmod to remove SUID/SGID bits.  Absence produces a warning.

CIS-CTL-4.9.title: COPY instead of ADD
CIS-CTL-4.9.objective: Dockerfiles MUST use COPY rather than ADD to avoid unintended remote URL fetching and archive extraction.

CIS-CTL-4.9.01.title: COPY instead of ADD
CIS-CTL-4.9.01.text: The Dockerfile MUST NOT contain any ADD instructions.

CIS-CTL-4.10.title: No secrets in Dockerfiles
CIS-CTL-4.10.objective: Dockerfiles MUST NOT embed secrets as ENV instructions.

CIS-CTL-4.10.01.title: No secrets in Dockerfiles
CIS-CTL-4.10.01.text: ENV instruction keys MUST NOT match patterns indicating credentials (password, secret, key, token, auth).

CIS-CTL-4.11.title: No unverified package installation
CIS-CTL-4.11.objective: Dockerfiles MUST NOT pipe downloaded content directly to a shell interpreter.

CIS-CTL-4.11.01.title: No unverified package installation
CIS-CTL-4.11.01.text: RUN instructions MUST NOT contain curl|sh, wget|bash, or equivalent pipe-to- shell patterns.

CIS-CTL-5.7-DF.title: No SSH in Dockerfiles
CIS-CTL-5.7-DF.objective: Dockerfiles MUST NOT install SSH daemons or expose port 22.

CIS-CTL-5.7-DF.01.title: No SSH in Dockerfiles
CIS-CTL-5.7-DF.01.text: RUN instructions MUST NOT install openssh-server, dropbear, or sshd.

CIS-CTL-5.7-DF.02.title: No SSH in Dockerfiles
CIS-CTL-5.7-DF.02.text: EXPOSE instructions MUST NOT include port 22.

CIS-CTL-5.28-DF.title: Specific image version tags
CIS-CTL-5.28-DF.objective: FROM instructions MUST specify a version tag and MUST NOT use the latest tag.

CIS-CTL-5.28-DF.01.title: Specific image version tags
CIS-CTL-5.28-DF.01.text: Every FROM instruction MUST include an explicit tag (not implicit latest).

CIS-CTL-5.28-DF.02.title: Specific image version tags
CIS-CTL-5.28-DF.02.text: The tag MUST NOT be the literal string latest.

CIS-CTL-5.5.title: No privileged containers
CIS-CTL-5.5.objective: No service in compose.yaml MUST use privileged: true.

CIS-CTL-5.5.01.title: No privileged containers
CIS-CTL-5.5.01.text: No service MUST have privileged set to true.

CIS-CTL-5.6.title: No sensitive host directory mounts
CIS-CTL-5.6.objective: Services MUST NOT bind-mount sensitive host directories (/boot, /dev, /etc, /lib, /proc, /sys, /usr).

CIS-CTL-5.6.01.title: No sensitive host directory mounts
CIS-CTL-5.6.01.text: No service volume MUST have a host source path starting with /boot, /dev, /etc, /lib, /proc, /sys, or /usr.

CIS-CTL-5.10.title: No host network namespace sharing
CIS-CTL-5.10.objective: Services MUST NOT use network_mode: host unless explicitly exempted.

CIS-CTL-5.10.01.title: No host network namespace sharing
CIS-CTL-5.10.01.text: No service MUST have network_mode set to host unless listed in exceptions.rego.

CIS-CTL-5.11.title: Container memory limits
CIS-CTL-5.11.objective: Every service MUST have an explicit memory limit configured.

CIS-CTL-5.12.title: Container CPU limits
CIS-CTL-5.12.objective: Every service MUST have an explicit CPU limit configured.

CIS-CTL-5.13.title: Read-only root filesystem
CIS-CTL-5.13.objective: Services MUST mount the root filesystem as read-only unless explicitly exempted.

CIS-CTL-5.13.01.title: Read-only root filesystem
CIS-CTL-5.13.01.text: Every service MUST have read_only set to true unless listed in exceptions.rego.

CIS-CTL-5.14.title: Specific host interface binding
CIS-CTL-5.14.objective: Published ports SHOULD bind to a specific host interface rather than 0.0.0.0.

CIS-CTL-5.14.01.title: Specific host interface binding
CIS-CTL-5.14.01.text: Published ports SHOULD NOT use bare numeric format (e.g. 80:80) which implies 0.0.0.0 binding.  Violations produce a warning.

CIS-CTL-5.16.title: No host PID namespace sharing
CIS-CTL-5.16.objective: Services MUST NOT share the host PID namespace.

CIS-CTL-5.16.01.title: No host PID namespace sharing
CIS-CTL-5.16.01.text: No service MUST have pid set to host.

CIS-CTL-5.17.title: No host IPC namespace sharing
CIS-CTL-5.17.objective: Services MUST NOT share the host IPC namespace.

CIS-CTL-5.17.01.title: No host IPC namespace sharing
CIS-CTL-5.17.01.text: No service MUST have ipc set to host.

CIS-CTL-5.21.title: No host UTS namespace sharing
CIS-CTL-5.21.objective: Services MUST NOT share the host UTS namespace.

CIS-CTL-5.21.01.title: No host UTS namespace sharing
CIS-CTL-5.21.01.text: No service MUST have uts set to host.

CIS-CTL-5.26.title: No new privileges restriction
CIS-CTL-5.26.objective: Every service MUST set the no-new-privileges security option.

CIS-CTL-5.26.01.title: No new privileges restriction
CIS-CTL-5.26.01.text: Every service MUST include no-new-privileges in its security_opt list.

CIS-CTL-5.27.title: Runtime health check
CIS-CTL-5.27.objective: Every service MUST have a healthcheck configuration in compose.yaml.

CIS-CTL-5.27.01.title: Runtime health check
CIS-CTL-5.27.01.text: Every service MUST define a healthcheck block in compose.yaml.

CIS-CTL-5.29.title: PID cgroup limits
CIS-CTL-5.29.objective: Every service MUST have an explicit PID limit configured.

CIS-CTL-5.31.title: No host user namespace sharing
CIS-CTL-5.31.objective: Services MUST NOT share the host user namespace.

CIS-CTL-5.31.01.title: No host user namespace sharing
CIS-CTL-5.31.01.text: No service MUST have userns_mode set to host.

CIS-CTL-5.32.title: No Docker socket mount
CIS-CTL-5.32.objective: Services MUST NOT mount the Docker socket.

CIS-CTL-5.32.01.title: No Docker socket mount
CIS-CTL-5.32.01.text: No service volume source MUST contain docker.sock.
